import json, os

        continue
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    print(f'\n=== {fname} ({len(data)} entries) ===')

    by_count = defaultdict(list)
    for k, v in data.items():

        print(f'  count={count}: n_batches={len(entries)}, mean_acc={mean_acc:.4f}, mean_bcs={mean_bcs:.4f}')
